processingDescriptions: Image analysis was performed with GenePix Pro 7 software (Molecular Device), background was defined with the “Local features background median” method.  Lowess normalization was applied in R (version 3.3.0) with the LIMMA software package (version 2.16.5). Spots corresponding to Synechococcus elongatus were extracted.  Four probes for each gene were spoted on the array. Mean signal of the four probes were calculated.
